Welcome to Foxwood, Coolshannagh - where modern living meets timeless charm.

This exceptional new residential development presents a boutique collection of 24 thoughtfully designed homes in one of Monaghan's most desirable locations.

Perfectly positioned just minutes from the heart of Monaghan town, residents will enjoy easy access to local schools, shops, and transport links, all while benefiting from the tranquillity of a welcoming, close-knit community.

These energy-efficient homes offer a lifestyle of convenience and connection, designed for how you want to live today and into the future.

Register your interest now and be part of something truly special at Foxwood, Coolshannagh
